subject: RE: Fixture confirmation - 8200 MT steel coils Constanta / Misurata
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge receipt of your offer dated 14 April 2026 concerning the transportation of 8,200 metric tonnes of steel coils from Constanta, Romania to Misurata, Libya aboard MV DANUBE STAR.

Following a thorough review of the proposed terms by our chartering committee, we are pleased to confirm that the offered freight rate of USD 22.00 per metric tonne on FIO terms, together with the stipulated demurrage rate of USD 7,500 per day pro-rata, is acceptable to Mitteleuropa Charter GmbH.

We hereby confirm the fixture on the following basis:

Cargo: 8,200 MT steel coils, stowage factor 15 cbft/mt approx
Load Port: Constanta, Romania — 1 safe berth, always accessible, always afloat
Discharge Port: Misurata, Libya — 1 safe berth, always accessible, always afloat
Laycan: 20–28 April 2026
Freight: USD 22.00/mt FIO
Loading rate: 1,500 MT SHINC
Discharging rate: 1,200 MT SSHEX EIU
Demurrage: USD 7,500 PDPR / despatch half demurrage
Commission: 3.75% total address

Kindly arrange for the fixture recap to be circulated at your earliest convenience so that we may proceed with the nomination of receivers and port agents.

With kind regards,
Dr. Klaus-Heinrich Brandt
Head of Chartering Operations
Mitteleuropa Charter GmbH (Demo)

subject: RE: MV RHINE CARRIER - 11000 MT project cargo Hamburg / Jeddah — Subject Vessel Approval
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your revised offer of 17 April 2026 regarding the shipment of approximately 11,000 metric tonnes of project cargo (oversized machinery components) from Hamburg, Germany to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

We are in principle agreeable to proceeding on the freight rate of USD 42.00 per freight ton W/M basis, subject to the following outstanding conditions being satisfactorily fulfilled:

1. VESSEL APPROVAL: Our principals require a full vetting of MV RHINE CARRIER including class certificates, P&I cover confirmation, and recent port state control records. We anticipate reverting with their decision within 48 hours of receipt of the complete documentation.

2. STEM CONFIRMATION: The shipper's loading schedule for Hamburg remains subject to final confirmation from their freight forwarding partner. We expect this to be resolved by close of business 19 April 2026.

3. CARGO DIMENSIONS: The oversized items (3 units, max 18m x 4.2m x 3.8m each) require a pre-loading stowage plan approved by the vessel's chief officer.

Once all three conditions are fulfilled to our satisfaction, we will convert this subject to a firm fixture without further delay. We trust this timeline is acceptable.

Yours sincerely,
Friedericke Sommer
Senior Chartering Manager
Mitteleuropa Charter GmbH (Demo)
snippet: Subject vessel approval + stem confirmation - USD 42.00/ft W/M - project cargo Hamburg / Jeddah...

Nikos
